notes.general_comments:
A total of 690 candidates took this paper with 70% of candidates achieving a score of 16 or more out of 30,
an increase of 7% over the previous examination. This is reflected in the median score of 20, with the mean
slightly lower.
Some questions proved easy to candidates, with Questions 3, 4, 8, 9, 14 and 18 answered correctly by 75%
or more of candidates. These questions mainly focused on financial accounting. Some questions did prove
difficult and showed a lack of basic knowledge by candidates. They are reviewed below.
